CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

What this is

ComPoM is an R package that fits Poisson-multinomial models to compositional count data (length/age frequencies) to standardise compositions for non-representative sampling and scale them to total catch. Backends are brms (Bayesian/Stan) and sdmTMB (ML/TMB, optionally with spatial and spatio-temporal SPDE fields). README.md has the workflow table and usage examples.

Commands

devtools::document()                                   # regenerate NAMESPACE / man (roxygen2)
devtools::test()                                       # all tests
devtools::test(filter = "post-proc")                   # one test file (tests/testthat/test-post-proc.R)
devtools::check(vignettes = FALSE)                     # as in CI (R-CMD-check.yaml)
covr::report(covr::package_coverage())                 # coverage

Tests fit real brms (1 chain, 200 draws) and sdmTMB models in tests/testthat/helper-sim.R and helper-sim-truth.R, which are sourced before every test file, so even a single test run pays that fitting cost. brms tests call skip_if_no_brms() (skipped without rstan). The spatial fixture needs distinct locations per year and a real spatial/year/season signal, otherwise the sdmTMB Hessian is not positive definite and predict(nsim) fails. ex_comp/ex_catch (data-raw/ex_data.R) are used by the examples, README and test-workflow.R.

CI (.github/workflows): R-CMD-check (multi-OS, plus a check that man//NAMESPACE are current), test-coverage, vignettes (renders all vignettes), pkgdown (GitHub Pages), release (on vX.Y.Z tags, notes from NEWS.md). Add a NEWS.md entry for user-visible changes.

Vignettes are slow (Stan/TMB fits) and not built in CI. vignettes/scenario_results.csv is generated by vignettes/run_scenarios.R (run from vignettes/, uses scenario_helpers.R) and read by the “Scenario Comparison” section of spatial_bias_simulation.Rmd. SCENARIO_SMOKE=1 Rscript run_scenarios.R runs a ~15 s smoke version.

Architecture

Pipeline, all in R/:

  • pre_proc.R: data_prep() aggregates counts to stratum x bin (adds zero counts and stratum totals; grouping variables become factors, including coordinates, so convert to numeric before building an sdmTMB mesh). parse_form() turns the term arguments into a model formula (ffx_form = bin-specific fixed effects, re_form = bin-specific IID random effects, cvars/spl = covariate smooths, mesh/time/coords = spatial fields). fit_model() builds the formula and fits with either backend.
  • post_proc.R: diagnostics and plots (post_pred_group, Fx_plot, cvar_smooth_plot, spatial_field_plot) and the scaling step. scale_comps() predicts numbers-at-bin draws for strata with known catch/CPUE. scaled_comp_plot() / scaled_ridge_plot() aggregate draws to catch-weighted compositions.
  • helpers.R: small shared utilities (gmean). Simulation-only helpers (Selectivity, scaled_comp_comp) live in vignettes/vignette_helpers.R, not in the package.

scale_comps() modes: mode = "catch" is catch weighting (all terms, including re_form random effects, at stratum levels, weighted by catch). mode = "index" predicts the population that a CPUE index describes. Terms in catchability and the re_form random effects are set to references, and all other terms are predicted at the values in grid (one row per time step, or per cell and time step for spatial fits), weighted by weight. Every ffx_form/cvars term must be in catchability or in grid. remove_nuisance = TRUE is a deprecated alias. The design is in dev/scale-comps-index-mode-plan.md.

For spatial models, scale_df must contain the coordinates, and the time column must have the same class (e.g. factor) as in the model data.

Repo notes

  • *.bak files (R/post_proc.R.bak, vignettes/*.bak) are scratch copies, excluded via .Rbuildignore. Do not edit them or treat them as source.
  • man/ and NAMESPACE are roxygen-generated (roxygen2 8.1.1). Edit the roxygen comments, not the Rd files.
  • Large data files in vignettes/ (*.RData, *.rda, *.rds) and figure/ are untracked working material.
